entities.name: PMID:27511825
observations: Case-control study of 154 young women with Rotterdam-criteria PCOS and 88 controls; included euglycaemic-hyperinsulinaemic clamp testing. SCH prevalence was 14% in PCOS versus 1% in controls (P<0.01).

entities.name: TSH-metabolic links stratified by weight
observations: In PCOS, TSH correlated with fasting glycaemia overall. In obese participants, TSH correlated with insulin secretion/resistance, DHEAS and cortisol, and inversely with oestradiol and SHBG; in nonobese participants, only waist-to-hip ratio correlated. SCH prevalence was similar by weight group (14% vs 15%), while SCH-associated metabolic/hormonal differences were reported only in obese participants.
